Name: Segment Model Shear Point Data
Description: This TRE contains DPPDB stereo model segment shear point data. Shear is a measurement of how closely aligned stereo segments are to one another.

SISEGID.Name: Segment Model ID
SISEGID.Description: This field indicates the ID of the segment model.

NBRSP.Name: Number of Shear Points
NBRSP.Description: This field indicates the number of shear points contained within the segment model (SISEGID).

LATSS<NBRSP>.Name: Latitude for Stereo Segment
LATSS<NBRSP>.Description: This field indicates the stereo segment latitude.

LONSS<NBRSP>.Name: Longitude for Stereo Segment
LONSS<NBRSP>.Description: This field indicates the stereo segment longitude.

ELVSS<NBRSP>.Name: Elevation for Stereo Segment
ELVSS<NBRSP>.Description: This field indicates the stereo segment elevation.

NBRASS<NBRSP>.Name: Number of Adjacent Stereo Segments
NBRASS<NBRSP>.Description: This field contains the number of adjacent stereo segments for this shear point.

ASSID<NBRASS<NBRSP>>.Name: Adjacent Stereo Segment ID
ASSID<NBRASS<NBRSP>>.Description: This field indicates the adjacent stereo segment ID.

LATASS<NBRASS<NBRSP>>.Name: Latitude for Adjacent Stereo Segment
LATASS<NBRASS<NBRSP>>.Description: This field indicates the latitude for the adjacent stereo segment.

LONASS<NBRASS<NBRSP>>.Name: Longitude for Adjacent Stereo Segment
LONASS<NBRASS<NBRSP>>.Description: This field indicates the longitude for the adjacent stereo segment.

ELVSS<NBRASS<NBRSP>>.Name: Elevation for Adjacent Stereo Segment
ELVSS<NBRASS<NBRSP>>.Description: This field indicates the elevation of the shear point in the adjacent stereo equipment in meters.

LATSHR<NBRASS<NBRSP>>.Name: Latitude Shear
LATSHR<NBRASS<NBRSP>>.Description: This field contains the latitude shear between the two points.

LONSHR<NBRASS<NBRSP>>.Name: Longitude Shear
LONSHR<NBRASS<NBRSP>>.Description: This field contains the longitude shear between the two points.

ELVSHR<NBRASS<NBRSP>>.Name: Elevation Shear
ELVSHR<NBRASS<NBRSP>>.Description: This field contains the elevation shear between the two points.
